# Invoice lifecycle (LIF)

What can happen to an invoice before and after it is issued: editing, issuing, duplicating, testing and retrying.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/lifecycle

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## Contents

- [LIF-001](#lif-001) — An issued invoice is never edited or deleted
- [LIF-002](#lif-002) — Only a draft can be issued
- [LIF-003](#lif-003) — Test in the sandbox, never with real invoices
- [LIF-004](#lif-004) — Retry writes with the same Idempotency-Key
- [LIF-005](#lif-005) — Duplicating an invoice creates a new one, not a copy

## LIF-001

**An issued invoice is never edited or deleted**

`MUST NOT` · Law · Impact: critical · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Once an invoice is issued, neither the invoice nor its billing record is changed or removed. Any correction goes through a later document: a corrective invoice or a void.

**Why:** The billing record is chained and, under VeriFactu, already with AEAT. An edit would make the invoice say something its record does not, and deleting it would leave a hole in the series.

**Applies to:** statuses `ISSUED`, `SENT`, `PAID`, `RECTIFIED`, `VOIDED`; operations `patchCompanyInvoice`, `deleteCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`STATUS_NOT_MODIFIABLE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/STATUS_NOT_MODIFIABLE), [`STATUS_NOT_DELETABLE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/STATUS_NOT_DELETABLE)

**Decides:**

- Edit: allowed in `DRAFT`, `SCHEDULED`; otherwise refused with `STATUS_NOT_MODIFIABLE`
- Delete: allowed in `DRAFT`, `SCHEDULED`; otherwise refused with `STATUS_NOT_DELETABLE`
- *You spot the mistake before issuing: the invoice is still a draft or scheduled.* → Edit or delete the draft. Nothing has been issued, so nothing needs correcting.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1007/2023 (RRSIF), art. 8.2.a) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2023-24840#a8

**Incorrect:** Patching the amount of an invoice that is already ISSUED: the API answers STATUS_NOT_MODIFIABLE.

```http
PATCH /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}

{ "lines": [{ "description": "Consulting", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 900 }] }
```

**Correct:** Issuing a corrective invoice against it, which leaves the original as it was.

```http
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/corrective

{ "rectification_type": "PARTIAL", "rectification_code": "R1", "reason": "Price agreed after delivery was lower", "lines": [{ "description": "Consulting (adjustment)", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": -100 }] }
```

**Related:** LIF-002, VOI-001, COR-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/invoice-lifecycle#what-each-status-allows · https://docs.beel.es/guides/amounts-and-rounding#issued-invoices-are-never-recalculated

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/LIF-001.md

## LIF-002

**Only a draft can be issued**

`MUST` · BeeL. rule · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Issue an invoice from DRAFT, or create and issue it in one call. Issuing assigns the number, sets the issue date to today and freezes every amount; a scheduled invoice is issued on its date, or returned to draft first.

**Why:** Issuing is the step that creates the fiscal document. Everything the invoice says is fixed at that moment, so it can happen only once and only from a draft.

**Applies to:** statuses `DRAFT`, `SCHEDULED`; operations `issueCompanyInvoice`, `createCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`ONLY_DRAFT_EMITTABLE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/ONLY_DRAFT_EMITTABLE)

**Decides:**

- Issue: allowed in `DRAFT`; otherwise refused with `ONLY_DRAFT_EMITTABLE`

**Incorrect:** Calling the issue operation on a scheduled invoice to send it out today: it answers ONLY_DRAFT_EMITTABLE.

**Correct:** Removing the schedule, which returns the invoice to DRAFT, and then issuing it.

**Related:** LIF-001, NUM-001, DAT-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/invoice-lifecycle#issuing

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/LIF-002.md

## LIF-003

**Test in the sandbox, never with real invoices**

`MUST NOT` · AEAT criterion · Impact: critical · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Do not issue test invoices with a production key. An invoice issued in production is a real invoice, sent to AEAT and numbered in your series, even if it was meant as a test; one issued by mistake has to be voided.

**Why:** AEAT does not accept fictitious invoices from a billing system in production. A test issued there stays in the series and in AEAT's records, and only a void takes it out of the books.

**Applies to:** Production API keys (beel_sk_live_…).

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Aclaraciones a dudas de los desarrolladores (v1.3), 11. Borradores de factura, pre-facturas, facturas proforma, albaranes, facturas de prueba — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/FAQs-Desarrolladores.pdf

**Incorrect:** Running an end-to-end test suite against production that issues invoices to a dummy customer.

**Correct:** Running the same suite with a sandbox key (beel_sk_test_…): invoices go to AEAT's test environment and never count.

**Related:** VOI-001, NUM-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/testing-in-sandbox · https://docs.beel.es/guides/proformas

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/LIF-003.md

## LIF-004

**Retry writes with the same Idempotency-Key**

`SHOULD` · BeeL. rule · Impact: critical · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. rejects the cases listed under the error codes; the rest is yours to check.

Send an Idempotency-Key header on every call that creates, issues, corrects or voids an invoice, and repeat the same key when you retry. A retried request then returns the first response instead of doing the work twice.

**Why:** Without it, a timeout followed by a retry can create or issue a second invoice. An issued duplicate consumes a number and a billing record, and can only be voided.

**Applies to:** operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `issueCompanyInvoice`, `createCompanyCorrectiveInvoice`, `voidCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH), [`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PROCESSING`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PROCESSING), [`INVOICE_DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/INVOICE_DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE)

**Incorrect:** Retrying a timed-out create call without a key, or with a new random key on each attempt.

**Correct:** Deriving the key from your own order id, so every retry of the same order sends the same key.

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.beel.es/api/v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BEEL_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: order-1042-invoice" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @invoice.json
```

**Related:** LIF-001, NUM-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/idempotency

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/LIF-004.md

## LIF-005

**Duplicating an invoice creates a new one, not a copy**

`MUST NOT` · BeeL. rule · Impact: medium · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Do not use the duplicate operation to replace a lost or damaged invoice. It creates a new draft that, once issued, is a different invoice with its own number and its own billing record; to hand over an invoice again, download the same PDF.

**Why:** Issuing the copy would invoice the same operation twice, in the series and in AEAT's records.

**Applies to:** operations `createCompanyInvoiceDerivation`

**Incorrect:** The customer lost the invoice, so you duplicate it and issue the copy.

**Correct:** You download the PDF of the original invoice again and send it.

```http
GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf
```

**Related:** CNT-011, NUM-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/invoice-lifecycle#duplicating-an-invoice

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/LIF-005.md
